title: Edit image prompts for one shot
caption: Setting, lighting, pose, camera and style words can be adapted for one shot. The shot mode controls its exclusions, and the picture library puts the newest pictures first.

images.caption: Shot controls and picture library, with local appearance, clothing and camera words. Synthetic test scene.
Setting and light have local words, template reset and explicit shared-template editing.
Style words and exclusions can be changed for one shot.
The shot mode remains at the top while editing camera words on a phone.
Local pose words with Reset to template.
